decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 3 - The wall coverings, plaster etc shall be carefully stripped to reveal any underlying timber frame that may exist, in addition to that which is already visible. If any further timber framework is found no part shall be cut or removed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority. A sample of the plasterboard metal stud work that would cover these timbers should be submitted for written approval by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Refurbishment of toilets on third floor including provision of disabled toilet (Listed building works)
